title: EmDash Apply keeps the pictures the importer placed: a seed picture path (JA Restaurant, JA Diner) never replaces an imported picture
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-restaurant/tests/personalize-imported-pictures.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-diner/tests/personalize-imported-pictures.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (6): keepImportedPictures puts the imported picture back for a seed path at a media-map spot and leaves a picture the run chose; a whole-seed Restaurant and Diner site, its pictures placed as the importer leaves them, keeps every picture after a personalize run with no model and with a model rewriting the rows.
evidence: 11/11/2026 on dev: a new site made through Add site from JA Restaurant 1.0.2 showed 8 broken pictures on Home and 17 on Menu at /images/joomlart/... after Apply, while the demo site restaurant-emdash, never personalized, served them from /_emdash/api/media/file/. Locally, with the fix bypassed, the model case lists slideshow items[0..2].image, features_intro img_icon and menu dish_image as source paths; Diner loses 6 pictures the same way.
fence: The write door of the personalize tool (writeEntry): a string at a media-map spot that equals the seed's value there is replaced by the value the site holds, before keepSiteRowKeys.

tests: keepImportedPictures: a seed picture path the site holds an imported picture for keeps the picture
a described restaurant keeps every picture the importer placed, with no model
a described restaurant keeps every picture the importer placed, with a model rewriting the rows
a described business keeps every picture the importer placed, with no model
a described business keeps every picture the importer placed, with a model rewriting the rows
